comment: Shared trip frame for the Seoul hotel-comparison itineraries. Defaults match the repo's master frame (arrive ICN Sun Nov 1 2026 21:00, depart ICN Sun Nov 22 13:00, 21 nights). Edit to the partner's real dates — the generated itineraries use these values in their headers.
title: Seoul hotel-comparison trip

frame.note: Dates are the planning frame from the master planner. Verify with the actual flight booking.

group: 2 adults (couple — just the two of you)
budgetPosture: Mixed — every itinerary scores value, but splurge options are flagged
singleHotelNote: Each itinerary assumes ONE Seoul hotel as the base for the whole Seoul stay — the point is to compare bases, not to switch hotels.

daySplit.arrivalNight: Night 1 is the late-arrival night (lands 21:00, hotel by ~23:30). Only the arrival night needs a 24-hour front desk; the generated plans mark where to verify this.
daySplit.middleCity: Daejeon or Cheonan (see Route A/B in trip-itineraries/)

status: CONFIRMED by user: master frame (Nov 1–22, 2026), couple, evenly balanced themes
